body.statement: With probability \(1-o(1)\) over \(G_n\), the procedure \((\mathsf D_G^{\mathrm{cap}},\widehat\tau_G)\) satisfies \[\sup_{y\in\mathcal M_2(G)}\mathbb E[(\widehat\tau_G-\tau_G)^2\mid G]\le C r(n,d).\] Moreover, the full-GATE conflict graph obeys \(\lambda(H_G)=\Theta(d^2)\) on the same graph event, so this guarantee is smaller by a factor of order \(\log(d+2)\) than the published \(O(\lambda(H_G)/n)=O(d^2/n)\) conflict-graph-design guarantee.
body.justification: This converts the covariance kernel into the first full two-sided procedure at the logarithmic lower-edge scale.
body.gap: Kandiros, Pipis, Daskalakis, and Harshaw give \(O(d^2/n)\) here, while Li and Li's sharper construction covers only the treated component.
body.consumer: Experimenters obtain the sample-size law \(n\gg d^2/\log d\) for vanishing worst-case GATE error rather than the sufficient law \(n\gg d^2\).
